study: Moreyra et al. 2025, A thorny tale

locus_universe.interpretation: The public matrices expose 1061 named locus columns. The paper reports 1064 initially mapped loci. The three-locus difference is preserved rather than silently reconciled.

why_exact_350_remains_unresolved: The public files reproduce raw HybPiper warning counts and sequence-recovery occupancy. The paper additionally used manual gene-tree orthology decisions for loci with 1-10 warnings and final alignment-level missingness/species-presence filtering. The public author repository contains no explicit final 350-locus list, retained alignments, per-locus gene-tree archive or final Newick tree.
allowed_claim: The public summaries reproduce a 531-locus pre-manual candidate set under the warning-count and raw occupancy criteria; they do not reproduce the exact retained 350 loci.
disallowed_claim: EAzami must not label any inferred 350-locus subset as the exact Moreyra-compatible panel without the original retained-locus list or full gene-tree/alignment archive.
